description: Data leakage prevention measures are not applied to systems and networks handling sensitive information.
applicability: Applies to organizations that do not implement data loss prevention (DLP) technologies and processes to detect and prevent unauthorized disclosure, transfer, or exfiltration of sensitive information through network, endpoint, or cloud channels.

metadata.detection_notes: Review DLP solution deployment (network, endpoint, cloud), DLP policies and rules, monitoring of data transfers, email and web gateway controls, USB/removable media restrictions, and incident response for data leakage events.
